mentions.name: Dimidium_Bellerophon
mentions.description: Dimidium_Bellerophon is a DSL (domain-specific language) for 3D printer automation, currently delivered as an IDE built on Java (Spark). Planned features include networking and printer management, and a non-planar slicer that outputs the DSL instead of static G-code, enabling more dynamic, point-by-point control of prints.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on https://github.com/Disla-Novo/Dimidium_Bellerophon, a DSL for 3D printer automation.
mentions.author: Disla_chunga

mentions.name: Bellerophon
mentions.description: Bellerophon is a DSL with a decoupled firmware adapter architecture for 3D printer control, letting the same source code compile to Klipper, Marlin, or RepRap without rewriting logic per target. It has been used to generate print patterns with math that a slicer wouldn't produce. The application is currently being migrated from browser localStorage to a proper JSON persistence layer.
mentions.problem: Printer control logic normally has to be rewritten for each firmware target (Klipper, Marlin, RepRap).
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Bellerophon, a DSL with decoupled firmware adapter architecture for 3D printer control, so the same source code can compile to Klipper, Marlin, or RepRap without rewriting logic per target.
mentions.author: Disla_chunga
